content.text:
ci.yml
dependency-review.yml
pi-assistant.yml
release.yml
81-        with:
82-          github_token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}
83:          provider: nvidia
84:          model: aws/anthropic/bedrock-claude-opus-5-5
85-          api_key: ${{ secrets.NVIDIA_API_KEY }}
86:          provider_base_url: https://inference-api.nvidia.com
87:          provider_api: anthropic-messages
88:          model_name: Opus 5.5
89:          model_reasoning: true
90:          model_input: text,image
91:          model_context_window: 1050000
92:          model_max_tokens: 128000 # Bedrock's maximum for Opus 5.5
93-          compat_force_adaptive_thinking: true
94-          # A released pit, not this checkout: pi edits the checkout, and its tools shouldn't change under it.
95-          extensions: github:cv/pit#v0.37.0
96-          # Load this repository's .pi/pit.json and .pi/functions (delivery.*, tests.*, pr.*), which AGENTS.md
97-          # relies on. Safe here: only OWNER/MEMBER can start a run, comment runs check out main, and fork PRs
98-          # get no secrets to mint the token.
99-          trust_project: true
100-          # pi-action's default is 30 minutes; use most of the job's 45, leaving time to save the thread.
101-          timeout: 2400
